params.initialOwner: Address that becomes the initial owner / executor.                     Should be the treasury wallet.
params.usdcAddress: ERC-20 token used for payments.  On Arc Mainnet:                     0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000

params.amounts: Parallel array of USDC amounts in raw units (6 decimals).                   Each amount must be > 0. Reverts if:   - batchId has already been used   - recipients is empty   - recipients.length > MAX_BATCH_SIZE   - recipients.length != amounts.length   - any recipient is address(0)   - any amount is 0   - any safeTransferFrom fails (e.g. insufficient allowance or balance)
params.batchId: A unique identifier for this batch (bytes32).                   Recommended: keccak256 of the off-chain batch UUID.                   Reusing a batchId that was already executed reverts.
params.recipients: Array of recipient wallet addresses (no zero addresses).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

MAX_BATCH_SIZE().notice: Maximum number of recipients in a single batch.

allowanceFrom(address).notice: Returns the current USDC allowance this contract has from `account`.         Use this to verify the approval before calling executeBatch.

executeBatch(bytes32,address[],uint256[].notice: Execute an atomic payroll batch. Prerequisites (caller must satisfy BEFORE calling this function):   1. Call USDC.approve(address(this), totalAmount) from the treasury wallet,      where totalAmount = sum(amounts).  The approval should be exactly the      batch total — not an unlimited approval.   2. The treasury wallet must hold at least totalAmount USDC.

isBatchExecuted(bytes32).notice: Returns true when the given batchId has already been executed.

usdc().notice: The USDC ERC-20 token contract used for all payments.

usedBatches(bytes32).notice: Records which batch IDs have already been executed.
